basic_details.job_title: AMU Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online

qualification.education_qualification: A Master's degree in Sunni Theology with 55% marks and Ph.D. Degree in Sunni Theology or equivalent.
qualification.details: Guest Teacher: A Master's degree in Sunni Theology with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or Fazil of any well reputed Sunni Madrasa with adequate knowledge of English or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. A Ph.D. Degree in Sunni Theology in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time.

salary_details.details: Guest Teacher: Rs. 50,000/- per month (@1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum)

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Guest Teacher: A Master's degree in Sunni Theology with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or Fazil of any well reputed Sunni Madrasa with adequate knowledge of English or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. A Ph.D. Degree in Sunni Theology in accordance with the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AMU Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: AMU Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) for filling temporary teaching positions in the Department of Sunni Theology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under Advt No. NO.01/2026?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Guest Teacher under the Department of Sunni Theology at Aligarh Muslim University for the academic session 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for AMU Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Teacher position in the Department of Sunni Theology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form as well as the hardcopy is 5 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for AMU Guest Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by Aligarh Muslim University for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master's degree in Sunni Theology with at least 55% marks along with a Ph.D. degree in Sunni Theology or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for the Guest Teacher position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, calculated at Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to a maximum limit.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for the shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the AMU Guest Teacher position is officially scheduled to take place on 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official AMU careers portal and subsequently submit a printed hardcopy of the application to the designated office.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and website links?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to the official notification PDF, online application portal, and official website in the Important Links section of this article.
